- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a code snippet to correctly save the `user` data when the "View Film Details" button is clicked: 
```javascript
$(".View").on("click", {user:user}, function(event) {
    sessionStorage.setItem("selectedFilm", JSON.stringify(event.data.user));
});
```
